name: DraftKings
outlook:
What DraftKings says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenue and adjusted EBITDADraftKings is updating its fiscal year 2026 revenue guidance range to $6.35 billion to $6.55 billion and its fiscal year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance range to $175 million to $275 million, primarily reflecting the Company’s increased Adjusted EBITDA investment in Predictions of $650 million to $700 million.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: investment in PredictionsThe Company expects Adjusted EBITDA investment in Predictions of $175 million to $225 million in the fourth quarter.
  • Full year 2027: revenue and adjusted EBITDADraftKings is introducing a fiscal year 2027 revenue guidance range of $7.35 billion to $7.75 billion and a fiscal year 2027 Adjusted EBITDA guidance range of $800 million to $1.0 billion.
  • Full year 2027: core businessThe Company expects fiscal year 2027 revenue from the core business of $6.7 billion to $7.0 billion, an increase of 4% to 9% year-over-year compared to the midpoint of fiscal year 2026 guidance, and Adjusted EBITDA from the core business of $1.15 billion to $1.25 billion.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 6, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
